question: In which of the following years was the Arjuna Award started in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2 (1961)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Arjuna Award is one of the prestigious sports awards in India.
 
• It was instituted in the year **1961** by the Government of India.
 
• The award is given annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It recognizes outstanding achievement in sports and games.
 
• The award includes a bronze statue of Arjuna, a certificate, and a cash prize.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**:

 
 
• It is the highest sporting honor of the Republic of India.
 
• Instituted in 1991–1992, it is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It is given for the most outstanding performance in sports over a period of four years.
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award**:
 
 
• This award is given to coaches for producing medal winners at prestigious international sports events.
 
• It was instituted in 1985.
 
• The award includes a bronze statue of Dronacharya, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**:
 
 
• Renamed as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021.
 
• It was initially named after former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• The award carries a medal, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**:
 
 
• These are one of the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• They are awarded in three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• These awards recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
